device: Primary PC CPU, 8 process-local OpenMP workers; no affinity, driver or system policy changes.
boundary: Steady-clock sum of complete experimental solver steps. Includes search construction/rebuild, Jacobi work, distance projection and accepted vector updates. Excludes initial scene/wall setup, observations, gzip, transport and independent analysis.
workload: New collision simulation from fixed recorded initial geometry, 0.5 simulated seconds; covers initial fall and impact. It is not a sustained six-second or production CUDA benchmark.
samples: One warm-up per size then five admitted samples per size, reversing resolution order each round. All serial; no task build/audit/transfer overlaps admitted solver timings.
interpretation: Report median and full range. Do not infer CUDA cost, whole-application throughput, or real-time suitability from this CPU reference.
source: Allocation-reuse reference; complete six-second n=6 and n=12 raw outputs matched the preceding reference exactly.
